title: Paint terrain color and alpha
summary: Tint terrain vertices and reveal a material overlay using alpha.
outcome: A selected terrain patch has the intended color or overlay blend.

sections.title: Paint a selected surface

steps.title: Set the paint
steps.text: Select the terrain, open Terrain color & alpha, and choose RGB color or Alpha, Brush opacity, and Brush radius.

steps.title: Stroke or fill
steps.text: Click Paint color or Paint alpha and drag on the terrain in Top view. Use Fill selected color or Fill selected alpha when the entire selected terrain should share that value.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Inspect the Camera view. Undo if the wrong patch or amount changed; lower opacity for a gentler stroke.

tips: Paint operations need a selected visible terrain patch; a brush face is not a terrain paint target.

sections.title: Blend an overlay material

steps.title: Prepare the material
steps.text: Select one whole terrain mesh and choose an alpha-blended material with a wc_ technique set in the browser.

steps.title: Add and reveal
steps.text: Under Blend a terrain overlay, click Add paintable overlay. Paint alpha in Top view to reveal the overlay over the base terrain.

tips: If the overlay button is unavailable, confirm the whole terrain is selected and the active material supports alpha blending with a wc_ technique set.
